Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2028 of 2023

Applicant :- Sageer Ahmad @ Sagheer Ahmad
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Prin. Secy. Home Dept. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Ajmal Khan,Prem Prakash Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Ajmal Khan, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Jayant Singh Tomar,
the learned Additional Government Advocate-I appearing on behalf of the State and Sri Ashok Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the complainant and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.185 of 2021, under Section 376 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Hussainganj,
District Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 30.08.2021 against the applicant and his son alleging that the informant got married to the applicant's elder son on 07.12.2018.

On 29.08.2021 she had gone to the applicant's house whereupon the applicant called the police and told her that her husband had divorced her and the informant had no right to stay in the applicant's house.

Police persons directed the informant to come to the police post at 7 P.M. The Sageer Ahmad @ Sagheer Ahmad vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Prin. Secy. ... on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/2785234/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. The applicant and his son had previously filed a writ petition being Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.25214 (MB) of 2021 and their arrest was stayed by means of the interim order dated 02.11.2021.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No.25214 (MB) of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: However, after the investigating officer submitted a charge-sheet on 30.07.2022, writ petition was dismissed on 18.08.2022.

Thereafter, the applicant and his son filed an application u/s 482 Cr.P.C.
No.7565 of 2023, in which time was granted to the respondents to file counter affidavit and that application is still pending.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim, no sign of use of force has been reported.
The investigating officer has recorded the statement of an independent witness who has not supported the allegations.

6. Although the informant has alleged allegation of rape against the applicant and his son at their house at Lucknow, location of mobile phone of the applicant's son has been found to be of Rudauli,
Faizabad at the relevant time, which raises a serious doubt against the allegations leveled by the informant.
7. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the applicant is innocent, and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

Informant has lodged two more cases against the applicant and his family members i.e. (i) Case Crime No.137 of 2021 under Sections 323, 498A IPC, 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act; and (ii) Case Crime No.381 of 2022 under Section 3/4 Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019.

entities.text: Muslim Women (Protection of Rights on Marriage) Act, 2019
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is 79 years of old person and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
10. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
